new_results.statement_short: For mutually independent hub and two original source banks, possibly dependent bank projections (L_i,V_i in R x R^r) with density caps M_i, arbitrary same-block phases, invertible symmetric Gamma, and alpha!=0, the density bound is ((r+2)/r)[L_H^2 M_A M_B/(alpha^2 |det Gamma|)]^(1/(r+2)); density is C0.

For cross block C=U Sigma V^T and hub-star vectors a,b, with delta_A=||(I-UU^T)a||, delta_B=||(I-VV^T)b||, the product-projection theorem gives density <=((r+2)/r)2^((r+1)/(r+2))[L_H^2/(delta_A delta_B product sigma_j)]^(1/(r+2)).
